column1: # Hungarian (hu) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_one_other` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | other (0, 2, 3 ...).
# After a numeral the noun stays singular (1 oldal, 0 oldal, 2 oldal), so both forms match.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Hungarian computing vocabulary (informal "te", nouns for commands such as Mentés and Megnyitás).
# No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI (Acrobat's included) was
# consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product and technology names (PdfCraft, PDF, Acrobat JavaScript ...) are not translated;
# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
